revolver.name: REVOLVER
revolver.description: A six-shot revolver built around timing, recoil, and loaded-round order.

moves.name: FIRE
moves.description: Fire the next round. The revolver must finish its spin before it can fire again.

moves.name: RELOAD
moves.description: Reload missing normal rounds. Reloading also grants 15 temporary health and 25% damage reduction for 1 second.

moves.name: CHARGED LOAD
moves.description: At full charge, dump the cylinder and load six charged rounds with extreme recoil.

wand.name: WAND
wand.description: A light magic weapon that throws spinning stars with strange movement.

moves.name: STAR
moves.description: Fire a small spinning star that passes through walls.

moves.name: HOMING STARS
moves.description: Fire three small stars with slight homing. They fade away after a few seconds.

moves.name: BOUNCING STAR
moves.description: At full charge, fire a large star that ricochets once, then bursts into twelve smaller stars on its next wall impact.

sake.name: SAKE
sake.description: A difficult stance weapon built around drinking, spills, buffs, and a dangerous drunk state.

moves.name: DRINK / GOURD THROW
moves.description: Normally, pull the gourd to your mouth and drink once every 5 seconds. Each drink fills one of 8 drunk slots and gives an equal chance at +25% melee damage, +25% defense, or 8 health regenerated over 5 seconds. At 8 slots you automatically enter the drunk state. While drunk, LMB throws the gourd toward the cursor every 3 seconds.

moves.name: SAKE SPIT / SAKE SPILL
moves.description: For 5 seconds after drinking, Q spits a messy fading cone of sake droplets with a 4 second cooldown. After that mouthful expires, Q tips the gourd and spills sake onto the ground with a 5 second cooldown, creating a slippery damaging puddle.

moves.name: CHUG
moves.description: Every 25 seconds, pull the gourd to your mouth and chug to enter a 15 second drunk state with +50% damage, defense, movement, and jump strength. Normal Q and E are disabled while drunk.
